name: Article 6, after § 1 – 122
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text: Member States shall ensure that natural and legal persons, as well as affected local communities, have access to effective judicial remedies against decisions, acts, or omissions related to environmental assessments. A claim may not be excluded in judicial proceedings solely on the grounds that it was not raised during the administrative proceedings. The rules of procedure must safeguard access to environmental information and public participation, as well as the rights under the Aarhus Convention.
